name: Aoba Veterinary
description: A calm block theme for a dogs-and-cats veterinary clinic: a white and pale-grey ground with one muted grey-green (#5F726E), Libre Baskerville over Source Sans 3. The home page opens on a full-bleed consult-room photograph with a 2 px outlined translucent statement box at the lower right and a white info bar with one booking button; it continues with a narrative intro, three numbered panels on square photo cards over a blurred band, the signs worth a visit, four ruled method rows, one recovery story on a parallax photograph with a 4.25rem proof figure, a full-width price list, the director's greeting and a solid timetable block. Ten inner pages and three recovery stories in English; the other four languages follow. Works without any plugin.
